name: C compiler in Python (Writing a C Compiler project)

mentions.name: C compiler in Python (Writing a C Compiler project)
mentions.description: A C compiler implemented in Python, built by working through Nora Sandler's Writing a C Compiler book. It handles operations on differently sized types and uses pseudoregisters to defer register allocation, with optimization chapters (framed as interesting algorithm problems) as the next focus.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been going through Nora Sandler's Writing a C Compiler book and writing a compiler in Python. I'm excited to start the chapters on optimization - those seem like the most fun algorithm problems.
